metadata.description: Khasi cuisine from Meghalaya is a delightful blend of indigenous flavors, emphasising simplicity and freshness. Rooted in traditional cooking methods, it features rice, pork, fish, and an array of foraged greens, herbs, and bamboo shoots. Smoked, fermented, and boiled preparations are common, adding depth to dishes. Signature foods include Jadoh, a flavorful rice and pork dish; Dohneiiong, pork cooked with black sesame seeds; and Tungrymbai, a rich fermented soybean delicacy. Meals often accompany Tungrymbai chutney and refreshing local drinks like Kyat (rice beer). Khasi food reflects the community’s deep connection with nature and sustainable living.
